description: Let a session key act for the account, inside its limits, on the listed markets until it expires. Replacing a session restarts its mint budget. The key is never held by this server. Returns UNSIGNED transaction data for the owner's own wallet; simulated first and refused if it would revert. Never signs or sends.

actions.description: Optional: narrow the actions. Default all nine

markets.description: Markets the key may use. Each needs a cap from prepare_mandate_set_limits

items.description: Market address (0x...) or symbol, e.g. NO-NVDA

validForSeconds.description: How long the session lasts, from now

name: prepare_mandate_grant_session
title: Prepare session grant
